title: Incident Triage Ribbon and Quick-Mitigations UI for Private Console
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Ship a compact, consistently visible 'Triage Ribbon' in the Private Console header that accelerates first-response for degraded tenant/network incidents. The ribbon surfaces a prioritized set of diagnostic signals, recommended next steps, and safe one-click mitigations with clear cost/availability tradeoffs. The component must be readable across cluster, VPC, and tenant pages and respect RBAC and audit logging rules.

Background: Operators now open multiple pages to triage network/cluster incidents (health, topology, logs, audit). That context-switching delays mitigations. This design explores a horizontally persistent UI element that summarizes incident severity, likely root causes (from heuristics and alerts), quick diagnostics (eg. latest flow log snippet, last failed control plane call), and one-click safe mitigations (eg. spin temporary worker nodes, promote fallback region, route around subnet) with explicit rollback and cost preview.

Success metrics: reduce median time-to-first-mitigation for private cluster incidents by 30% in pilot tenants; increase operator confidence (survey + qualitative sessions); zero accidental escalations caused by ambiguous microcopy.

Constraints and non-goals: not intended to replace full incident timelines or deep debug flows. No automatic, policyless autoremediation. Actions are gated by RBAC and require explicit confirmation for high-cost or irreversible operations. Must not surface secrets or PII.

Key interactions: ribbon appears collapsed by default when no active incidents. When an alert or SLO breach is detected, the ribbon expands showing severity badge (color & icon), top-3 correlated signals (latency, packet-drop, KV-cache-miss), suggested short explanation, and up to 3 contextual actions with explicit cost/downtime badges. Hovering an action reveals a micro-runbook snippet and link to the full runbook. Actions open a secure modal with parameter knobs and a preview of cost and rollback plan. All actions append audit entries and are traceable to user tokens.

Data sources: Alert manager, console telemetry (latency/cost), KV cache metrics, flow logs, recent rollout events, tenant quotas, and runbook snippets stored in Confluence/Drive. Ribbon should pull a single condensed signal payload (<=2KB) to avoid header bloat.

Accessibility: Color choices must pass AA contrast. All actions reachable via keyboard; ARIA labels for severity and actions. Confirmation modals include clear accessible copy for screen readers.

Design notes: We prototyped three variants — Inline Ribbon, Floating Toast, and Command-Palette Shortcut. Team recommends Inline Ribbon for discoverability and context persistence. Visual language borrows compact pill badge system from Console header but introduces a small timeline sparkline and cost chip.

Tradeoffs: Inline Ribbon increases header real estate; to mitigate we collapse non-critical signals after 10 minutes. More aggressive summarization reduces diagnostic depth — tradeoff accepted for faster mean time to mitigation on high-severity incidents.

Launch plan: pilot on 5 enterprise tenants with SRE partners; instrument telemetry for ribbon open rate, action click-through, time-to-confirmation, and rollback frequency.

Deliverables in this ticket: hi-fidelity Figma prototype (interaction flows), microcopy bank for actions and confirmations, accessible color tokens, design handoff package, and a lightweight spec for the backend signal payload and RBAC checks.
acceptance_criteria: Ribbon renders on cluster and tenant pages when alerts exist
Actions respect RBAC and write audit entries
Confirmation modal shows explicit cost and rollback plan
Hover reveals runbook snippet and link to full runbook
Color tokens meet AA contrast and keyboard nav works
Prototype reviewed by Eng and PM with documented feedback
comments: 2026-03-02 - Marta Ruiz: Initial concept review with ENG and PM. ENG raised concerns about signal payload size; agreed to cap payload at 2KB and fall back to link to full timeline. Action: ENG to provide minimal payload schema (ENG-79220).
2026-03-04 - Priya Nair (PM): Asked to include explicit cost-estimate chip for each action and an opt-in telemetry consent for pilot tenants. Added to microcopy and telemetry checklist.

2026-03-06 - Samir Khan (SRE): Suggested adding a 'safe revert' pre-check that validates rollback path before enabling the promote-region action. Design updated to grey out action if pre-check fails and show tooltip explaining reason.
2026-03-08 - Design critique: prefer Inline Ribbon (variant A) over Floating Toast for discoverability. Noted potential header crowding; agreed to auto-collapse low-priority ribbons after 10 minutes.

2026-03-09 - Security review note (sec-team): No secrets allowed in snippets; ensure runbook links are IAM-protected. Marked security_review_required=false for this ticket but upstream private deployment package will require review.
